title: Chicken Soup

items.item: chicken bones (in a food mesh saver bag, tied twice)
chicken broth (Tabatchnick wholesome chicken broth, or organic Imagine vegetarian no-chicken broth)
water (a few cups, if too salty)

instructions: Take 2 pieces of chicken (including thighs and legs) and rip off the skin using a paper towel. Cut the parts of the fat that you can't rip off and chop off the chicken's tushy. Place the chicken pieces in a pot.
Place chicken bones in a food mesh saver bag and tie twice, then add to the pot.
Peel one onion and place in the pot. Put 3-4 whole garlic cloves in the pot (depending on size). Add 2 cartons of chicken broth. Cover pot and bring to a boil.
Once it boils, lower the heat and let simmer for 2 hours or longer (make sure it keeps bubbling gently).
Cut up vegetables: 2-3 potatoes, 1 celery, 2-3 carrots (depending on size), 1 turnip, 1 parsnip (not sure if I like it).

Remove chicken and bones from pot after simmering. Cut off chicken from bones (make sure to remove all bones/tendons) and then re-add chicken to the pot. Add vegetables to pot. Can also add water (may need a few cups if too salty).
Add spices: sprinkle coriander, cumin, pepper, and a little turmeric.
Bring soup back to a boil. Lower flame and cook for another hour (can add noodles 10-15 min before hour is up).
notes: Oil is easier to take off after the soup has been in the fridge. Noodles can be added 10-15 min before the last hour is up.
